summary: PASS for the DG0 candidate b7f60ed3 (7fab49c). Every required command passes in a disposable clone: extraction, 50/50 gate tests, 26/26 agent tests, register, pipeline, reconcile, the candidate ID, and prefreeze with all 11 lines PASS. All A24/A25 rejections pass, plus 8 new independent cases (5 of them fail on the round-14 commit). Register integrity has 0 errors, the ten LOAD runs are verified, the live guard and sandbox probes behave as documented, and every A01-A28 scenario is feasible. F-DG0-235 is verified fixed, and F-DG0-231/233/234 are re-verified fresh. Two new Low observations: F-DG0-236 (the working-tree candidate ID counts concurrent sandbox stubs, fail-closed) and F-DG0-237 (the threat model understates where reviewer shells can create new files, which is detected).
